headline: Industria turística impulsa sostenibilidad en proyectos hoteleros
summary: Juan Bancalari, president of the Dominican hotel and tourism association Asonahores, said the tourism industry continues to expand with up to 11,000 new hotel rooms planned between 2026 and 2028. He called for sustainability in planned investments.
why: Hotel room supply and tourism investment drive real-estate, construction and services revenues in tourism-dependent economies such as the Dominican Republic.
